newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm, shipowners sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm, shipowners sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers kept their offers high on Friday but shipowners were largely sidelined, showing little interest, traders said.

A pre-weekend mood also dampened sentiment slightly, they said. The 380-cst was quoted at $102/$103 and the 180-cst was at around $108/$109. MDO and gas oil were at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively.

"Except for routine customers, not many shipowners will be interested in Singapore's high prices," said one supplier. "But there's no way we can lower our offers when the cargo market is strong." -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
